coverSnippets.label: Strategic account partnership
coverSnippets.text: Constellation gives {BIZ} one operating system for enterprise revenue work: account strategy, executive coverage, AI signal intelligence, coordinated outreach, proposal generation, and investment review in a single CRM-native motion.

coverSnippets.label: Why Constellation
coverSnippets.text: Most CRMs record activity after the fact. Constellation helps strategic account teams decide what to do next, why it matters, who owns it, and how it advances the account plan before the opportunity stalls.

coverSnippets.label: Demo-friendly implementation
coverSnippets.text: The recommended rollout starts with a focused enterprise pilot: activate the Command Center, import target accounts, configure Cognito signals, launch priority Campaigns and Sequences, and publish proposal and IRR workflows for the revenue team.

customPageSnippets.label: Enterprise CRM thesis
customPageSnippets.text: Constellation turns CRM from a passive database into an enterprise selling cockpit. Account plans, relationship maps, deal strategy, next steps, proposal assets, and executive signals live together so leadership can see where attention is creating pipeline.

customPageSnippets.label: Command Center rollout
customPageSnippets.text: The Command Center gives sales leaders a live view of account health, priority pursuits, stuck opportunities, campaign execution, and proposal readiness. It is designed to make the next best action obvious without asking teams to leave their workflow.

customPageSnippets.label: Cognito signal motion
customPageSnippets.text: Cognito scans account, contact, and market context for timely expansion triggers. Those signals feed campaigns, sequences, account plans, and proposal narratives so reps can act on executive-relevant moments while the window is still open.

customPageSnippets.label: Proposal Studio
customPageSnippets.text: Constellation Proposal Studio connects account strategy to polished customer-facing assets. Teams can assemble a multi-page proposal, reuse approved messaging, pull structured pricing, and include ROI or IRR context without rebuilding the story from scratch.
